_provenance.status: Every profile below is PENDING. None has passed E-PROF (plan 7.4).
_provenance.consequence: Production defaults to explicit user selection. Automatic classification stays disabled until a profile is VALIDATED with zero held-out misidentifications and a bounded upper confidence limit in every supported stratum.
_provenance.supported_client_size_px: Profiles are fitted for a 1280x720 CLIENT area. A different viewport size abstains rather than rescaling.

provenance.source: seven owner-supplied crops of the live arrow across dirt, grass, water and pale terrain, measured 2026-08-28
provenance.note: The band is deliberately LOOSE and generates proposals only. On grass the arrow's green chromaticity is 0.518 and the grass behind it is 0.520, so no colour rule can separate them - local contrast, the two-notch topology and the rest of the score do that (DECISIONS.md D-024). Area bounds span 0.04% to 46% of the canonical frame because the arrow fills a quarter of the view when the player stands under it. E-PROF has not been run.

provenance.source: owner-supplied frames: one map, one session, one Mac, one render configuration
provenance.note: The R~=G relationship is ONE candidate among several (plan 2.2). Seed values only; E-PROF must fit and gate them on labelled splits before this can be selected automatically.

provenance.source: tests/corpus/real, TUNE split only (pink-a, purple-a, desert-a, sand-a, sand-near-a), measured 2026-08-28
provenance.note: Colour bounds chosen where arrow-pixel coverage was 92-98% per tune stratum with surround leakage at or below 4%: |R-G| <= 40 (v0: 28) admits the arrow's shaded side; blue gap 65 keeps pale sand (min(R,G)-B about 52) outside. The area floor is half the smallest labelled tune arrow (1140 px box) because the occluded arrow beside the player fell under v0's 900 px floor; the ceiling admits the arrow filling the view. Evaluated on the EVAL split by treasure.py --detector-report --corpus. Not validated: one session, one map, one machine (E-PROF PENDING). Exclusions: the top menu band (0-40 px) and the hotbar band (672-720 px) of the canonical raster, where yellow progress bars and hotbar icons were measured to acquire as arrows on a live capture (tests/corpus/real live-sluice); no labelled arrow in the corpus overlaps either band (lowest label top 124 px, lowest label bottom 509 px).
Deliberately broad so E-PROF can measure its false-acquisition rate against the narrower candidates. Not intended for production as written.
